reader.requirement: At --std 85, SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING subtracts each elementary numeric item of identifier-1 from the corresponding (same name and qualifiers, §1985:VI.6.4.3) elementary numeric item of identifier-2 and stores it there, as separate subtractions, skipping FILLER, REDEFINES, OCCURS and non-numeric (including numeric-edited) items, with ROUNDED applying to every pair and the ON SIZE ERROR imperative run only after all pairs are done.

edition-consulted.switches: perPair = DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 a group operand's subscripts are identified afresh for each pair (docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-CORR85, kb/Work PB5185); from 2002 once at the start
DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: 85 continues after an unphrased size error

reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel|DialectBehaviors|Edition.Year over CorrespondingBinder.cs, CorrespondingEmitter.cs, ArithmeticEmitter.cs: the two hits above.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: per-pair identification of a subscripted group operand at 85 (start-of-statement from 2002) and the unphrased size-error continuation; pair selection and the per-pair subtraction are the same arm.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f14_02 and pb5185 cover matching and per-pair subscripts; not exercised here: FILLER/REDEFINES/OCCURS/edited exclusions together, ROUNDED, and the size error imperative running after every pair.

probes.expected: A 3-10=-7; B 0-1.6 ROUNDED -2; C (alphanumeric), E (REDEFINES), F (OCCURS), M (numeric edited) and FILLER unchanged; nested K 6-4=2; ZZ 0-50=-50
D (PIC 9) overflows: unchanged, E after it still stored before the imperative runs (§1985:VI.6.4.2 last paragraph); unphrased: execution continues, D undefined

probes.printed: COBOL1757: SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING operand 'WS-A' is an elementary item

reader.notes: CorrMatch selects the pairs by the 1985 corresponding rules and CorrespondingEmitter#Emit stores each through StoreInPlace with its own size-error guard, the phrase dispatched after the last pair. Probe output agrees with the 1985 text in every pair; at 2023 subgr3b printed the same.
